verdict.rationale: n8n has a first-party 'Use the command line' docs page, and a probe confirms an official CLI is documented there. However, it sits under self-hosted instance configuration, and the evidence gives only the page title, not what the commands do. Missing for 10: details of CLI commands and scope (e.g. workflow export/import, execution), any evidence it is designed for agent or AI-native use, cloud availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
